name: Happening! (1) ~Osananajimi-tachi wa Mahou Shoujo~
original_name: はぷにんぐ!(1)～幼馴染達は魔法少女～
source:
A guy who can't catch a break ends up surrounded by his four magical childhood friends, getting into all kinds of trouble.

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE246026.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
一个无法休息的人最终被他的四个神奇的儿时朋友包围，陷入了各种各样的麻烦。

[来自[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE246026.html]DLsite英文[/url]]
